def score(f, p, hw, w):

    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # A nearly empty final CTA wave loses useful machine throughput.

    # One-wave or otherwise poorly amortized grids expose scheduling startup.
    s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[2]
    # CTA dispatch cost is fixed per CTA, so compress its wide normalized range.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.dispatch_overhead_per_flop) * w[3]
    # Local-memory spill traffic is an especially expensive extra data path.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[4]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # Short pipeline fill/drain remains a cost on the bandwidth path.
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[5]
        # In the bandwidth regime, replicated operand traffic is the primary cost.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[6]
        # Poor tile coalescing directly increases global-memory transactions.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.coalescing_stride_ratio) * w[7]
        # Lost raster locality removes cache reuse and raises memory traffic.
        s = s + f.raster_locality_deficit * w[8]
        # Low tile arithmetic intensity makes each fetched byte less productive.
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[9]
        # Parallel split-K partial materialization adds bandwidth demand.
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[10]
    else:
        if p.log_flops < 40:
            # On short reductions, fixed prologue/epilogue cost dominates staging.
            s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[11]
            s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[12]
            # Each scarce mainloop iteration exposes loop and barrier latency.
            s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[13]
        else:
            # On long reductions, steady-state transfer hiding can amortize staging.
            s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[14]
            s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[15]
            # Iteration cost is less dominant once the pipeline reaches steady state.
            s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[16]
        # In the compute regime, unfilled thread slots reduce latency hiding.
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[17]
        # Register allocation pressure limits resident work and issue hiding.
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[18]
        # Instruction work per useful arithmetic competes with tensor issue slots.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[19]
        # Serial split-K dependencies reduce independent accumulator work.
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[20]
        # Extra parallel-reduction arithmetic is paid on a compute-bound path.
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[21]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # output-boundary overwork grows multiplicatively with the tile overhang
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # register spills cause an abrupt local-memory path
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[1]
    # the final CTA wave can leave SM capacity unused
    s = s + f.tail_waste * w[2]
    # serial split-K exposes a dependency between partial accumulations
    s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[3]
    # parallel split-K adds global partial write/read traffic
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[4]
    # each reduction iteration carries loop-control and pipeline synchronization cost
    s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[5]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # pipeline fill/drain is exposed more directly when bandwidth and latency dominate
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[6]
        # stage count trades prologue/epilogue work against operand latency hiding
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[7]
        # repeated operand loads are the principal bandwidth cost
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[8]
        # low-intensity CTA tiles consume bandwidth for little arithmetic
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[9]
        # a long raster reuse window reduces cache reuse
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[10]
        # stages beyond the two-stage family amplify exposed fill/drain cost
        stage_excess = np.log2(1.0 + np.maximum(f.pipeline_stage_family_count - 2.0, 0.0))
        s = s + stage_excess * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[21]
        # extra multistage buffering consumes shared memory and reduces residency
        s = s + stage_excess * f.shared_memory_pressure * w[22]
        # extra multistage buffering also consumes registers and reduces residency
        s = s + stage_excess * f.register_file_pressure * w[23]
    else:
        # compute-bound kernels still pay pipeline prologue and epilogue overhead
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[11]
        # stage-time tradeoff captures latency hiding versus excessive staging
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[12]
        # wide-range front-end work competes with tensor arithmetic
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[13]
        # unfilled thread capacity reduces latency hiding
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[14]
        # register allocation pressure limits concurrent work
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[15]
        # parallel split-K also adds accumulator arithmetic in this regime
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[16]
        # stages beyond the two-stage family amplify exposed fill/drain cost
        stage_excess = np.log2(1.0 + np.maximum(f.pipeline_stage_family_count - 2.0, 0.0))
        s = s + stage_excess * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[24]
        # extra multistage buffering couples stage choice to shared-memory occupancy
        s = s + stage_excess * f.shared_memory_pressure * w[25]
        # extra multistage buffering couples stage choice to register occupancy
        s = s + stage_excess * f.register_file_pressure * w[26]
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 256:
        # with little output per SM, static issue work is partly a launch-amortization cost
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_burden_per_thread) * w[17]
        # internal thread coordination still matters for small-output tiles
        s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[18]
    else:
        # once SM output work is ample, per-thread instruction issue is repeatedly exposed
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_burden_per_thread) * w[19]
        # adequate output work does not amortize poor internal thread granularity
        s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[20]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Boundary predication: compress the wide output-tile overwork range.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # Last-wave idle time grows superlinearly as the surviving wave empties.
    s = s + (-np.log(np.clip(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1.0e-6, 1.0))) * w[1]
    # Register spills are a discontinuous transition to very slow local memory.
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[2]
    # Spill severity captures the amount of local-memory traffic after that transition.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
    # Split-K partial traffic and serial accumulator round-trips add global-memory work.
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[4]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.serial_reduction_traffic_fraction) * w[5]
    # Serial split-K also removes independent accumulation work.
    s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[6]
    # Retain the parent stage-latency model as a continuous baseline.
    s = s + np.log2(f.stage_latency_time_ratio) * w[7]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # Below the roofline, replicated operand loads and poor coalescing consume bandwidth.
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[8]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_eviction * w[9]
        s = s + f.operand_contiguity_deficit * w[10]
        s = s + f.output_store_run_density * w[11]
        # Wasted swizzle span is more costly when rectangularity limits useful reuse.
        s = s + f.swizzle_extent_underfill * (1.0 + p.output_aspect_imbalance) * w[21]
    else:
        # Above the roofline, issue overhead and resource occupancy limit tensor throughput.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[12]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[13]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[14]
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[15]
        # Underfill remains a distinct, weaker grid-scheduling cost in compute-bound shapes.
        s = s + f.swizzle_extent_underfill * (1.0 + p.output_aspect_imbalance) * w[22]
    # The family label captures the discrete MmaPipelined versus multistage mechanism change.
    s = s + f.stage_family_indicator * w[16]
    # MmaPipelined exposes fill/drain latency, while multistage pays absolute loop granularity.
    if p.log_reduction_depth < 4:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * (1.0 - f.stage_family_indicator) * w[17]
        s = s + (np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) / 60.0) * f.stage_family_indicator * w[18]
    else:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * (1.0 - f.stage_family_indicator) * w[19]
        s = s + (np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) / 60.0) * f.stage_family_indicator * w[20]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[1]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.tail_waste / np.maximum(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1e-6)) * w[2]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[3]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[4]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.grid_instruction_overhead_ratio) * w[5]
    if p.output_aspect_imbalance < 0.5:
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
            s = s + np.log2(f.raster_band_count) * w[6]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(f.raster_band_count) * w[7]
    else:
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
            s = s + np.log2(f.raster_band_count) * w[8]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(f.raster_band_count) * w[9]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[10]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[11]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[12]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[13]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[14]
        if p.alignment_deficit < 0.5:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[15]
            s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[20]
            s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[21]
            s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[22]
        else:
            s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[23]
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[24]
            s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[25]
            s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[26]
            s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[27]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_critical_path_ratio) * w[16]
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[17]
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[18]
    else:
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[19]
    s = s + np.where(f.pipeline_stage_count < 3, f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction, 0.0) * w[28]
    s = s + np.where(f.pipeline_stage_count < 3, 0.0, np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio)) * w[29]
    s = s + np.where(f.pipeline_stage_count < 3, f.shared_memory_pressure, 0.0) * w[30]
    s = s + np.where(f.pipeline_stage_count < 3, 0.0, f.register_file_pressure) * w[31]
    return s
